title: Raku and Pit-Firing Events
source_quote: Firing Raku or the Pit occur Spring, Fall and Winter but due to summer heat and burn conditions we rarely will fire during summer months.
evidence_sentence: The Alternative Firing page lists raku firing as available in spring, fall, and winter months.
evidence_quote: Firing Raku or the Pit occur Spring, Fall and Winter
summary: Raku firings happen seasonally (spring, fall, winter). Current students pay $20 to audit or $50 to participate with their own pots. External artists cannot use the raku kiln. Contact Tanya to join the notification list for firing schedules.
cost_text: Current Students: $20 to audit, $50 to participate; Advanced Students: included in class; External Artists: pit-firing only ($75 bring own, $95 using school materials)
how_to_join: Contact Tanya@cedaroakfarm.org or call (704)750-9821 to get on the notification list for firing schedules.
bring: Own bisqued pots (raku clay recommended); external artists must provide their own pots
